sections.heading: 1. Keep it simple
lines: ① One anchor habit: a walk or 10 min of moves.
② Long drives and lunches: up every 30–60 min.
③ Beach cricket or a hike? Start shorter.
④ Hot day? Move early or late, water and hat.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get it checked if…
lines: You feel dizzy or unwell — stop and rest.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

slides.title:
Plan your new year with Hybi
at Hybrid Physio!

caption:
The Christmas break shakes up every routine. Your body still likes to move. ☀️

You don't need a perfect holiday program. One anchor habit, like a morning walk or ten minutes of exercises, goes a long way when every day looks different.

Gym closed? Swap rather than stop: a beach walk, swim or bike ride all count. Get up every 30 to 60 minutes on long drives and lunches, start new activities like beach cricket or a hike with a shorter version, and move early or late on hot days with plenty of water.

If a niggle keeps building, or you want a plan for the new year, our team at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
